# William Lopez-Cordero

> AI Enablement & IT Lead at Handl Health, based in Los Angeles and working remotely. Focus: AI enablement, workflow automation, and IT operations.

William leads AI adoption across Operations, Customer Success, Sales, Marketing, and Legal. He trains employees, administers Claude Enterprise and connectors, manages AI governance, researches agentic engineering for product data integrity, and runs IT as the sole lead. His Handl Health work delivers 2× business value relative to AI spend, not doubled employee productivity.

## Background
- Handl Health: AI Enablement & IT Lead, May 2026–Present.
- Bello: Founding Engineer, July 2023–May 2026. Production platform serving 60K+ users; Blueprint Protocol generated $2M+ in revenue; AI content pipelines powered 1M+ downloads.
- Elphi: Co-Founder & Head of Architecture, 2018–2023. Mortgage platform reduced origination time by 30%+; engineering team grew from 2 to 10+. Supported SOC 2 audit efforts with Drata and JAMF.
- MIT: BS Aerospace Engineering, 2014–2019. Earlier work includes NASA JPL, MIT Space Systems Lab, and Lockheed Martin’s Skunk Works.
- Availability: Planning select AI enablement engagements in 2027. No exact start date announced.
